registry_info.description: The Unit: robots with three actions - drive, turn the chassis, turn a hub - and what two of them become when a rod joins them.

the_unit.name: The Unit
the_unit.description: A small robot with exactly three controllable actions: move forward or back, turn its chassis, turn an independent hub that carries a pin. One unit with a pen on the pin draws a closed four-loop rosette. Two identical units joined hub pin to hub pin by a 1 m rod, each driving a fixed circle and giving way, linearly, to the force at its own pin (what a back-drivable motor does), settle from most starts within about ten minutes into one relation neither programme contains: about 73 degrees between headings, turning at about three quarters of their programmed rate (0.185 against 0.25 rad/s, hubs 0.77 against 1.0); a second relation near 45 degrees also holds. Three units in a triangle of rods (a tighter programme, w0 0.8) settle into one relation from every start tried, their pens weaving a spirograph ring. Mechanical coupling (level 2 of Palle's three), not units that adapt (level 3). setup pair | triangle | apart (the control: same units, same starts, no rod) | one. The model and the rule: unit_sim.gd. Bench: commons/testing/probe_the_unit.tscn.
